body:
ira: Heads up — saw a bump in org attribution after the routing-policy toggle in canary. ~3% of traffic fell back to org for ~10m. log: `authz: fallback=org reason=header_missing request_id=rdw-8f7b`

nate: Which header? We rely on `x-project-id` being preserved by the proxy.

sasha: Proxy sanitization change dropped unknown x-* headers in the last deploy. That likely removed `x-project-id`. I left a note but missed a follow-up.

ira: Upstream had `x-project-id: proj-21`. Downstream is missing it; token claim still exists but mapping prefers header.

ops-bot: alert: org:org-3 quota soft-threshold crossed at 09:12 UTC. Paging SRE.

mike-support: If customers were attributed to org vs project, support needs an export with request_id and time window.

nate: Immediate actions: 1) revert sanitization in canary 2) flip mapping precedence to prefer token when header absent 3) add unit/regression test for header passthrough.

sasha: I'll open the PRs. Also adding a sampled telemetry event `authz.fallback` with labels reason and route to help triage.

ira: UX/doc note: on the console toggle add a warning: "Routing preference affects billing attribution; enable in canary only and monitor attribution panel." Small copy prevents surprises.

nate: Can we gate rollouts with a guard that aborts if org attribution rises >1.5% absolute for 5m?

sasha: Yes, adding rollout guard and a dashboard panel for header_vs_token attribution.

ira: Revert landed in canary at 09:25 UTC, alerts quieted. I'll run a log query and share CSV with Mike.

mike-support: Thanks. Support will prepare customer comms if needed.

nate: Good triage. Re-open if alerts recur. :white_check_mark:
